Several new members were enrolled and gratifying reports were heard from all committees. It was decided to forward to the general society in New York the sums already raised by subsoription, amounting to $55, which money is to be used in the furnishing of the hospital ship. It is not generally known that this Association is the only one working under Government direction.

Women's National War Relief. The Mount Vernon branch of the Women National War Relief Association will hold its meetings every Tuesday at 4 o'clock p.m, at Willard Hall. This society is not international ta character, it acts under the direct supervision of the United States governmeur, and cares for our soldiers and sailors. Everyone

is cordially invited to these meeting, where the work accomplished and to be accomplisbed will be fully explained.
